projects.name: E – Transport ( Vahan 4 & Sarathi 4 )
details: Development and maintenance of data replication packages, troubleshooting database issues, and query development.
Analyzed source system transaction patterns and designed CDC architecture in ODI 11g/12c to support scalable incremental data movement for national e-Transport applications.
Ensured data quality and compliance by validating CDC data against business rules and regulatory reporting standards mandated by Government of India systems.
Supported production deployments and post-release validation of CDC processes, including backfilling data and reinitializing journals when required.
Analyzed requirements and designed database schemas for applications.
Collaborated closely with project managers, designers, and other developers in order to complete tasks efficiently and effectively.
Generated reports from databases using SQL queries.
Created SQL Server Integration Services packages for incremental and full loads of data from various sources.
Developed ETL packages to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources into a data warehouse.
Involved in creating database objects such as tables, views, indexes based on business requirements.
Optimized existing queries for better performance using SQL query tuning techniques.
Designed complex reports using SQL Server Reporting Services.
Integrated multiple data sources into one unified view using views or joins in SQL queries.
Developed ETL processes using SSIS packages for loading data from various sources into a data warehouse environment.
Generated ad hoc reports upon request from stakeholders utilizing Microsoft Excel Pivot Tables or Access Queries.

projects.name: E-Transport ( Vahan & Sarathi )
details: Development and maintenance of data replication packages, troubleshooting database issues, and report generation.
Developed and implemented data warehouse models for various reporting requirements using SQL Server 2008, 2012, 2014.

Configured and managed journalizing (Simple and Consistent CDC) using ODI Knowledge Modules, handled subscription management, and ensured data consistency across multiple transport databases while processing high-volume transactional data.

Designed and implemented Change Data Capture (CDC) in ODI 11g and 12c to capture incremental changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) from source transport systems (vehicle registration, license, permit data) and load them into the central data warehouse, ensuring near real-time data availability.
Created SSIS packages to extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into the Data Warehouse.
Worked with Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau and Power BI for creating interactive dashboards.
Maintained documentation related to all aspects of Database Design and Development activities like ER diagrams, DDL scripts.
Investigated issues reported by end users related to data quality and accuracy within the Data Warehouse environment.
